# Scrollbar

```ts
import { Scrollbar } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The cake& scroll surface (Figma "Scrollbar", node 123:6261). Wrap any overflowing content and it gets the design-system scrollbar: a grey thumb that rests thin (4px) and widens (8px) while you interact with it. Use it wherever a bounded region needs to scroll — menus, panels, long lists, wide tables.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The scrollable content. |
| `maxHeight` | `number \| string` | — | Caps the viewport height; the vertical scrollbar appears when content overflows. |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| string` | — | Caps the viewport width; the horizontal scrollbar appears when content overflows. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'both'` | `'vertical'` | Which scrollbars to render. |
| `viewportProps` | `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadixScrollArea.Viewport>` | — | Props forwarded to the scrollable viewport — add padding/layout here. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadixScrollArea.Root>, 'children'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Scrollbar } from '@/cakeand/components/Elements';

<Scrollbar maxHeight={240}>
  <LongList />
</Scrollbar>

// horizontal
<Scrollbar orientation="horizontal" maxWidth={360}>
  <WideTable />
</Scrollbar>
```

```tsx
import { nativeScrollbarStyles } from '@/cakeand/components/Elements';

const Viewport = styled(Select.Viewport)`
  \${nativeScrollbarStyles}
`;
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-stroke-border-high`, `--radius-50`, `--space-050`

## Accessibility

- Radix keeps the region natively scrollable, so keyboard and screen-reader scrolling keep working — the styled thumb is a pointer affordance layered on top, never a replacement.
- The primitive doesn't trap focus or alter tab order; focusable content inside scrolls into view normally.
- The thumb rests thin but stays the token grey (--color-stroke-border-high), which meets contrast against the container surfaces in both themes; the widen-on-hover is an enhancement, not the only signal that it's scrollable.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Wrap a bounded region (maxHeight/maxWidth) so there's something to scroll. | Wrap unbounded content — with no cap nothing overflows. |
| Reuse this element (or nativeScrollbarStyles) for every scroll surface. | Hand-roll ::-webkit-scrollbar rules per component. |
| Let type="auto" hide the bar when content fits. | Force type="always" on short content that never scrolls. |
| Keep content keyboard-reachable inside the viewport. | Rely on the thumb as the only way to scroll. |

---

- Behaviour comes from a Radix primitive; cake& owns the visuals.
